tools.name: lookup_phone_number
tools.description: Look up who is behind a phone number in the Netherlands, Belgium or Luxembourg: community reports, spam and scam categories, a trust verdict, and the registered business if there is one, from the Calmido phone directory. Use it whenever someone asks who called them, whether a number is safe, spam or a scam, or which company a number belongs to. Accepts international (+31 20 123 4567) and national (020 123 4567) formats; pass `country` for a national number outside the Netherlands. The verdict is one of: business (no reports, a known registered business), empty (no reports and no known business: not a sign that the number is safe), neutral (reported, but not enough evidence to flag), safe (reported, and the community found nothing alarming), suspicious (flagged as a threat), restricted (the identity was erased on request; the reports remain) or unavailable (the lookup could not be read: it says nothing about the number). An invalid number returns an error. Calls are rate limited per address; over the limit the error says how many seconds to wait.

number.description: The phone number: international (+31 20 123 4567, or 31201234567 without the plus) or national (020 123 4567, starting with 0). Spaces, dashes and brackets are ignored.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country (NL, BE or LU) of a national-format number, which starts with 0. Ignored for an international number. Defaults to NL; if the number is not valid there, BE and LU are tried.

language.description: Language of the summary sentence, the category name and the page link: nl, en or fr. Defaults to en.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find a phone number in the Calmido directory (Netherlands, Belgium, Luxembourg). The query is a phone number, international (+31 20 123 4567) or national (020 123 4567); it is not a name or free text. Returns the matching directory entry, if any. Pass its id to `fetch` for the verdict and reports.

query.description: A phone number, international (+31 20 123 4567) or national (020 123 4567).

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Retrieve who is behind a phone number from the Calmido directory: the community verdict, the number of reports, the most reported category and the registered business, with a link to the evidence. The id is the one `search` returned: the number in E.164 digits.

id.description: The id `search` returned: the number in E.164 digits.
